description: Horizon des batailles (lot EP2, ADR 0032). Purement visuel, aucune règle. relief : tuiles de relief réel cuites par `cent-ans geo horizon` (game/assets/horizon/relief), raccord au champ et anneau d'horizon ; haze : brume de distance (densité du brouillard par météo quand l'horizon est actif, allègement en altitude) ; panorama : bande peinte cylindrique recalée sur la ligne d'horizon réelle ; panoramas : bibliothèque d'images peintes (générées par `cent-ans horizon-panoramas`, invites ci-dessous) ; rules : choix du panorama (première règle qui s'applique) ; silhouettes : clochers, châteaux et fumées lointains posés sur l'anneau.

channel_coast.label: Côte de la Manche
channel_coast.prompt: the far distant coastline of the English Channel in northern France: pale chalk cliffs and low grassy downs fading into haze, dunes and salt marsh, a strip of grey-green sea at the foot of the land

pyrenees.label: Pyrénées
pyrenees.prompt: the chain of the Pyrenees mountains seen from the foothills of Bearn, 50 km away: a long wall of jagged grey-blue peaks with snow patches, layered forested ridges in front fading into blue atmospheric haze

alps.label: Alpes
alps.prompt: the high Alps seen from a valley far away: tall snow-capped peaks, glaciers and dark rocky faces, layered pine-covered ridges in front fading into cool blue atmospheric haze

massif_central.label: Massif central
massif_central.prompt: the volcanic uplands of Auvergne in the Massif Central seen from afar: rounded extinct volcano cones and long plateaus, dark pine woods and brown moorland, layered ridges fading into haze

wooded_hills.label: Collines boisées
wooded_hills.prompt: rolling wooded hills in eastern France (Vosges, Morvan, Ardennes) seen from far away: rounded forested summits of oak, beech and fir, several layers of ridges fading into blue haze

picardy_plains.label: Plaines de Picardie
picardy_plains.prompt: the open chalk plain of Picardy seen to the far horizon: very gentle low ridges, wide fields of ripening wheat and fallow, small dark copses and lines of trees, a very low and flat horizon fading into haze

norman_bocage.label: Bocage normand
norman_bocage.prompt: the Norman bocage seen to the far horizon: gently rolling green country, small pastures enclosed by dense hedgerows of oak and ash, small woods, soft layered low hills fading into moist haze

loire_valley.label: Val de Loire
loire_valley.prompt: the wide Loire valley seen from a slope: flat valley floor with meadows, willows and poplars, faint glints of the wide river, low tufa hills and forests on the far side fading into soft haze

gascony_hills.label: Coteaux de Gascogne
gascony_hills.prompt: the rolling hills of Gascony seen to the far horizon: long soft ridges and valleys, vineyards and golden fields, oak woods on the slopes, warm hazy light, layered hills fading into haze

flanders_flat.label: Plat pays de Flandre
flanders_flat.prompt: the flat country of Flanders seen from a church tower, only the far distance several kilometres away: perfectly flat wet meadows and fields, small distant rows of willows and poplars, a very low flat horizon at mid-height of the picture, fading into grey haze; no road, no near trees

moorland_hills.label: Landes et collines des îles Britanniques
moorland_hills.prompt: the moorland hills of northern England, Wales and Scotland seen from afar: bare rounded fells with heather and bracken, rocky crags, few trees, layered ridges fading into cool grey haze

mediterranean_hills.label: Collines méditerranéennes
mediterranean_hills.prompt: dry Mediterranean hills of Provence and Languedoc seen to the far horizon: limestone ridges with garrigue scrub, olive groves and dark cypresses, pale rocky crests fading into warm haze

winter_lowlands.label: Hiver
winter_lowlands.prompt: a snowy winter countryside of northern France seen to the far horizon: gently rolling hills covered with snow, bare leafless woods drawn in dark grey, frosty hedgerows, a cold pale haze

prompt_template: Distant landscape backdrop for a historical strategy game, realistic oil painting in the style of 19th-century landscape painters, wide horizontal format. {prompt}. The upper half of the picture is an empty, perfectly plain and uniform pale sky with no clouds, no sun and no birds. Only the far distance is shown: no foreground, no people, no animals, no buildings, no roads, no text, no signature, no frame.
